config.design: Capture adjective-last-subtoken and following-period positions at blocks0-5: input, embedding skip, attention input/output, normalized MLP input/output, residual output. Exact factorial bilinear decomposition and residual accounting. Separately capture attention5 current-value and native layer0 value bus.
config.alignment: Use last adjective subtoken; competent familiar adjectives are all single tokens. Multi-subtoken failed-cohort diagnostics do not represent the sum of all adjective-source contributions. Period verified by token ID13.
config.limits: Descriptive native trajectory only; local versus inherited refers to normalized MLP input, so normalization can introduce interaction. No claim that earliest nonzero term is semantic. Failed cohorts remain diagnostics; no fitting or reserved-test access.

audits.independent_direct_MLP_scope: all six layers and both positions, four competent quartets
